_comment: Pokemon Unite collection. Each name in 'lines' brings in its WHOLE evolutionary line. The 18 lines were picked with `generate.py pick --count 18 --seed unite-holowear` (lines may be shared with other collections since #24), then given a look each (three lines per look). Shared look in styles/_unite.py.

readme.title: Pokemon Unite
readme.summary: Pokemon in team-colour holowear outfits (inspired by Pokemon Unite's holowear; original designs). Regular = purple team, shiny = orange team.
looks: each line wears one outfit: a team jersey (Pikachu, Timburr, Blitzle); glowing hex-grid holowear (Genesect, Beldum, Bronzor); a sequinned concert outfit (Cutiefly, Hatenna, Glimmet); a tuxedo with a team bow tie (Mawile, Snubbull, Komala); a festival yukata (Cherubi, Delibird, Cubone); a Hawaiian beach shirt (Tyrunt, Cufant, Tapu Bulu)
the holowear grid and sequins sparkle in the dark; the eyes keep their own colours
